Astra and Sol 6.2 evals on Perplexity. Good improvements on Wide-and-Deep-Research performance

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Perplexity (@perplexity_ai); megjelent: 2026-11-17T22:10:02+00:00; link: https://x.com/perplexity_ai/status/2122814545639223348; média: 1 kép]
GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are now available in Perplexity Search and Computer.

On our WANDR benchmark, GPT-6.2 Astra scored 0.783 at about $12.54 per task, up 0.095 from GPT-6 Astra.

GPT-6.2 Sol hit 0.746 at about $2.65, up 0.065 from GPT-6.1 Sol.
